_notes.form_endpoint: URL the /contact form POSTs to (the Cloudflare Worker in worker/, or a Formspree form URL). Leave empty and the form opens a pre-addressed email instead.
_notes.turnstile_sitekey: Cloudflare Turnstile site key. Leave empty to skip the widget (the honeypot still runs).
_notes.linkedin: Confirm the final company page URL.
